review_description: Took a little while to get a quote but installation was swift and well organised. We are very happy with our system. Still waiting on ergonomic for the smart metre though.
Every little thing was taken care of by the company and a good job done
Yes did all those things, and left the site clean and tidy. Great service.
Ben from Prestige was the only one that didn’t promise me things that he couldn’t. The install team were great and the quality of work was 100%
They were quick to install and explained everything about the system and how to trouble shoot if anything went wrong

The entire process was without complication; from receiving and accepting the quote to the installation of the system in less than three weeks.The sales representative from Prestige Renewables was able to clearly communicate with us and was sympathetic to our needs.The installation was flawless; with the removal of our old, defunct system, installing the new set up, cleaning up and  organising the grid connection afterwards.

Nick made a couple of suggestions that made me go with Prestige. A 10 amp plug was added to my inverter so I can use solar if power is out and a plug for a generator was added to my power board. A hot water timer was included as standard.Upgrade to a hybrid inverter was reasonable in terms of price. Price was competitive and Prestige are local to Mackay.Installation went well and was done quickly.  The connection has been organised but is still pending.The system is significantly exceeding my expectations for electricity production.

They were very quick one week after deposit. The team were punctual and never stoped until the job was done. Very tidy job and good hand over told me everything I wanted to know. They organised grid connection and everything else

The sales and quotes were similar from the three providers. The installation went smoothly from 07:00 until 12:00. They made the arrangements for Ergon to connect to the grid. Expected to happen in the next 3 weeks.
Neat and tidy very polite installers very informative sales person prestige renewables kept me inform all the way through
Nick and his team provided on time professional service.  Many thanks
